input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 contains a full exit package that meets the preferred position: 11.1 gives up to six months' transition assistance on any expiry or termination at the expiring Order Form rates (better for us than "then-current rates"), including knowledge transfer, migration and cooperation with a replacement supplier; 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, documented, machine-readable format and bars withholding data over a fee dispute; and 11.3 requires secure deletion after confirmed return with written officer certification, with any legally retained copy remaining protected. Section 16.5 expressly leaves Customer Data governed by Sections 11 and 15, so the confidentiality return/destroy provision does not cut across these rights. No walk-away features (no immediate deletion, no data hostage) are present, so no redline is warranted.
